name: craftflow
description: Judgment-driven engineering for Codex: understand the problem, choose a proportionate change, and verify the result.

interface.shortDescription: Make the right change with engineering judgment.
interface.longDescription: Set clarifies the decision; Go completes the change. Two independent skills for investigation, design, planning, review, implementation, and verification, with technical references loaded only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Use $craftflow-set to investigate this problem or review this change without editing code.
Use $craftflow-go to implement this change and verify the result.
